import { signInWithUsername, redirectIfLoggedIn } from '../js/auth.js'; // If already logged in + approved, go straight to the app redirectIfLoggedIn(); const form = document.getElementById('login-form'); const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn'); const statusMsg = document.getElementById('status-msg'); const pwInput = document.getElementById('password'); const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-pw'); const iconShow = document.getElementById('icon-show'); const iconHide = document.getElementById('icon-hide'); // Show / hide password toggle toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { const isHidden = pwInput.type === 'password'; pwInput.type = isHidden ? 'text' : 'password'; iconShow.style.display = isHidden ? 'none' : ''; iconHide.style.display = isHidden ? '' : 'none'; }); function showStatus(message, type) { statusMsg.textContent = message; statusMsg.className = `status-msg show ${type}`; } function setLoading(loading) { if (loading) { submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.innerHTML = ' Signing in…'; } else { submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.textContent = 'Sign In'; } } form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); statusMsg.className = 'status-msg'; // hide previous const username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim(); const password = document.getElementById('password').value; if (!username) { showStatus('Please enter your username.', 'error'); document.getElementById('username').focus(); return; } if (!password) { showStatus('Please enter your password.', 'error'); pwInput.focus(); return; } setLoading(true); try { await signInWithUsername(username, password); // Success — redirect to app window.location.href = '../index.html'; } catch (err) { if (err.message === 'pending') { showStatus('Your account is pending approval. Please wait for admin confirmation.', 'warning'); } else { showStatus(err.message || 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.', 'error'); } } finally { setLoading(false); } });
